workstream_3_material_semantics_measurab.principle: a material is not visually validated merely because it has a label; semantic_material_mapping (coverage) and minimum observable contrast (rendered pixels) are SEPARATE gate checks
workstream_3_material_semantics_measurab.instrument: the renderer shoots a material probe (one sphere per distinct semantic class, same light-rig directions/intensities + tone mapping as the hero, shadows off) and records the pixel rect per class; the gate crops the central 60% of each rect from the saved PNG, converts mean sRGB -> Lab (D65) and measures CIEDE2000 for every pair of distinct classes
workstream_3_material_semantics_measurab.threshold: material_distinction_min_de00 = 10.0 (~4x the CIE just-noticeable difference of 2.3, CIE 142:2001; Sharma/Wu/Dalal 2005 implementation notes) — provenance, class (PRESENTATION), uncertainty (+/-1.5) and measurement recorded in visual_compiler_thresholds.json rev 3 (Art. XXVII)
workstream_3_material_semantics_measurab.no_threshold_rescue: the threshold was NOT tuned to the fixtures: the R442 palette measured 15/78 pairs below the bar (body_metal vs machined_metal at 1.01 — BELOW JND) and the palette was RE-DERIVED (12 iterations, measured each time) until every pair of distinct classes separates in the RENDER; scripts/r443_palette_measure.py + r443_iter_palette.py (session scripts) hold the measurement trail
workstream_3_material_semantics_measurab.palette_disposition: SEMANTIC_MATERIALS re-derived; semantic characters preserved (steel dark gunmetal, aluminum mirror-chrome, copper copper); 'default' is deliberately a flagging magenta — an UNCLASSIFIED part must be noticeable (Art.
